agency: City of Houston Public Works, Houston Permitting Center

who_may_file.conditions: State law exempts homeowners who own and reside in a dwelling from state electrician licensing (Tex. Occ. Code 1305.003(a)(6)), unless regulated by city ordinance; Houston Permitting Center electrical permit pages state 'Registered electrical contractors' must apply.
who_may_file.quote: Also, there is an exemption for homeowners who reside in the home to do the work if the electrical work is not regulated by city ordinance.

requirements.item: Meter mounting device shall not be used for a supply-side tap to interconnect Electric Power Production Sources
requirements.quote: In addition, the Meter Mounting Device shall not be used for a supply side tap to interconnect Electric Power Production Sources

requirements.item: Submit formal solar interconnection application, sign Interconnection Agreement (ICA), and obtain Permission to Operate (PTO)
requirements.quote: Approve and issue the Interconnection Agreement (ICA) and Permission to Operate (PTO). Maintain and operate the Utility meter device on site (automatically, remotely reprogrammed to capture excess generation export readings).
